svg.title: Joint verification scenes: several contracts compiled together
svg.desc: Seven joint scenes drawn as cards, in the order the report presents them. A filled box is a contract the prover compiles and a dashed outline a CVL model written by hand. A box is drawn only for a contract the report names in Verification Scope; the other contracts and faces a scene carries (among them the GasService Gateway_LinkedMessageProcessor compiles for its gas reads) are in the scene and not in the picture. An arrow is drawn only for a call some rule of the scene reaches, and its label is the field the call goes through. A compiled neighbour indents what it reaches a rung further in, so a contract reached only through a compiled child appears at the third level: HubHandler_LinkedHubCore shows Hub reaching Accounting. A second line beginning with an arrow names another compiled contract of the card that the box reaches: Holdings and ShareClassManager reach HubRegistry on Hub_LinkedHubCore, and Hub reaches Holdings on HubHandler_LinkedHubCore. A compiled contract nothing in the scene reaches is not drawn: SpokeHandler_LinkedRegistryFactory also compiles an Escrow, but the escrow its factory deploys is left to the prover as an unresolved call. Gateway_LinkedMessageProcessor reaches its MessageProcessor for each message's length, pool and source network; the processing itself is cut at the per message step, so no handler is drawn behind it. A chip on a card's title row names a key the scene's setup pins: 1 for the one symbolic pool or share class its configurations pin, and a dark 2 beside it where the scene also runs a Multi configuration of its own on two pools, share classes, networks or asset rows; networks and asset rows are drawn only where a scene splits them. A configuration that pins fewer keys (Metadata, Unpinned, Custody, Census) is left to the scene's bounds, and a card without a chip pins no pool or share class in its setup.

g.text: and a separate configuration runs on two, for isolation rules
the setup pins one symbolic pool (likewise share classes, networks, asset rows)
